harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Dovecot IMAPS is operational on node1 for the dedicated archive account. Node2 authenticated and verified both messages, including Message-ID, body, and read/unread state. The staged mailbox remains byte-for-byte intact. Both nodes were rebooted individually and recovered with changed boot identities.
actions_performed: Installed the Ubuntu 24.04-compatible Dovecot package without upgrading the operating system or kernel.
Created a dedicated archive account and node-generated demonstration password. The root-only password file is /root/archive-demo-password on both nodes.
Copied the messages into a separate service Maildir, preserving one.eml as read and two.eml as unread.
Enabled Dovecot at boot and restricted authentication to the dedicated archive password database.
Verified retrieval from node2 over IMAPS using read-only mailbox access.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially, verifying changed boot IDs and full recovery after each restart.

evidence.requirement: Working IMAP service with dedicated archive authentication
evidence.summary: Dovecot is enabled and active; archive authentication succeeds; only the dedicated passwd-file/static user configuration is active; credential files have restricted permissions.

evidence.requirement: Both messages preserve Message-ID, bodies, and read/unread state and are retrievable from node2
evidence.summary: Node2 authenticated over IMAPS and retrieved exactly two messages: <one@branch.test> with body 'Shipment arrived.' and Seen=true, and <two@branch.test> with body 'Shipment departed.' and Seen=false. The final proof was captured after both reboots.

evidence.requirement: The supplied staged mailbox remains intact
evidence.summary: Initial and final hashes, sizes, ownership, modes, and mtimes match for mailbox.tsv and both source messages. Working-copy message hashes also match their staged originals.

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel were retained
evidence.summary: Node1 remained Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS on kernel 6.8.0-71-generic; Dovecot 2.3.21 was installed from the compatible Ubuntu repository.

Healthy baseline boot ID 96c08b66-5aa4-4e9a-b76f-04e2c6e34ced was captured, reboot acknowledgement returned, boot ID changed to 5792b799-a6a0-4d72-b20a-7c93c905f226, and service, authentication, hashes, mailbox state, and remote retrieval recovered.

Healthy client baseline boot ID 72e73f96-de03-4bf7-b4eb-7485bb2b99f1 was captured, reboot acknowledgement returned, boot ID changed to 7c379343-f371-446e-8631-1cb3c2b89cfa, and node2 again authenticated and verified both messages and their states.

attempts.summary: Dovecot IMAPS is operational on node1 for the dedicated archive account. Node2 authenticated and verified both messages, including Message-ID, body, and read/unread state. The staged mailbox remains byte-for-byte intact. Both nodes were rebooted individually and recovered with changed boot identities.
